name: Dakar
tagline: Atlantic capital of music, Gorée Island and thieboudienne
summary: Dakar sits on Africa's westernmost tip, a vibrant city of music, art and surf. Take the ferry to historic Gorée Island, see the African Renaissance Monument, visit the pink Lac Rose, surf at Ngor and eat thieboudienne, Senegal's national fish and rice dish.
seasonNote: November to May is dry and breezy; July to October is hot and rainy.
arrival: Blaise Diagne Airport is about 45 minutes away by the toll road.
gettingAround: Taxis (agree fares), Yango app and the TER train.
cashTip: Prices are shown in euros; locally you pay in West African CFA francs (XOF), pegged at 656 XOF to 1 euro. Carry cash for taxis, markets and the Gorée ferry.
foodTip: Thieboudienne, yassa chicken and grilled fish.
buyTip: Fabrics, sand paintings and djembe drums.
